notes.title: Unpossess Version 3.0 IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Unpossess: Exorcism Simulator version 3.0 is now released!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019950/bf0b1fba22d85233fa0c9ae936106e3720a2c74b.png"]

Here are the changes included in this release:

A brand new case: The Possession of Sarah

Added new challenges

New creature skins

Game branding updates

Fixed bugs related with the existing challenges

Fixed bugs related with the equipment customization desk

Fixed navigation mesh bugs related to "The Possession of Victor" case

New ambient audio jumpscares

UI and UX enhancements

Lighting improvements

Graphical improvements

Optimization improvements

Translation updates

Have fun and see you in-game!

Chreseeba (solo developer)

notes.title: Unpossess: Exorcism Simulator Version 3.0 Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi Steam,



I would like to announce to you another update for Unpossess: Exorcism Simulator, which will be released in September, just in time for Halloween.



This new update will include:

A new case

New creatures

New jumpscares

Various quality of life improvements and bug fixes

New menu theme

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019950/87cd113d7143e04b393787c7ffd32ae43620f511.png"]

I've also started working on a new project that builds on the lessons I learned while developing Unpossess. It's still in the early stages, but I can't wait to share more with you soon!

Feel free to join the Discord by clicking here.

Catch you later!



— chreseeba (solo dev)

notes.title: Early Access Version 6.1
notes.notes:
Hi Steam Community!

I've added a new patch (version 6.1):


 Reverted recent change related to ultra-wide monitors causing black bars (please note that support for ultra-wide monitors is currently experimental)
 Increased the maximum FOV to cater for ultra-wide monitors (please note that support for ultra-wide monitors is currently experimental)
 Disabled the crucifix / holy book durability game mechanic to balance gameplay (might introduce it again later on)
 Updated in-game ambient fog
 Updated in-game graphics and art style to match the 1900s (open to suggestions, let me know about this change)
 Added new optimization changes
 Bug fixes related to stopping demonic attacks and exorcisms


My focus will now shift to preparing and releasing full version 1.0 which will include another new map, new jumpscares and tutorial updates.

Have fun! Kindly support me by leaving a positive Steam review if you like the game! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Early Access Version 2.0 is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam Community!  

Early Access Version 2.0 has arrived, bringing the following updates:  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019950/64574919b8a8f6f460a5666dab5127669438dfad.png


 Fixed dark ghost material and animations
 Fixed placement of relics in Maria's case
 Fixed character heads going through the mantle or cape
 Fixed show tips setting bug
 Fixed find freezing temperature area objective bug
 Fixed bug related to the haunted object collection
 Fixed bug related to muting and unmuting players
 Fixed minor bugs related to possessions and attacks
 Fixed bug related to objective not counting when placing a holy item
 Fixed camera positioning when the possessed dies
 Fixed possessed animations
 Added new building / toggle building items tip
 Enhanced the holy book equipment animation
 Invite players now show online and away friends only
 Session code is now hidden when entering it in the find session by code screen
 Added new audio jumpscares
 Added insane mode difficulty
 Added new case (Michael)
 Added new translations


A heartfelt thank you to everyone who plays the game daily, creates content, provides feedback, and reports bugs. 

Thanks to your support, the game has achieved a 'Mostly Positive' rating, and as a solo developer, I couldn't be more happy. 

Behind the scenes, I've been hard at work on this update and planning even more content for the future.  Psst. I am already working on the next update!

If you’re enjoying the game, please consider leaving a positive review on Steam—it really helps! 

If you have suggestions or concerns, constructive feedback is always welcome to help me improve. 

Let's make Unpossess something remarkable!
 
Enjoy and have fun!

- chreseeba, the solo developer behind Unpossess
